verses.arabicText: قُلْ أُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْءَانًا عَجَبًۭا
verses.transliteration: Qul ūḥiya ilayya annahu is'tamaʿa nafarum-mina l-jini faqālū innā samiʿ'nā qur'ānan ʿajabā
verses.translation: Say, [O Muhammad], "It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, 'Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur'an.

verses.arabicText: يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشْدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ وَلَن نُّشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدًۭا
verses.transliteration: Yahdī ilā r-rush'di faāmannā bihi walan-nush'rika birabbinā aḥadā
verses.translation: It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone.

verses.arabicText: وَأَنَّهُۥ تَعَٰلَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا ٱتَّخَذَ صَٰحِبَةًۭ وَلَا وَلَدًۭا
verses.transliteration: Wa-annahu taʿālā jaddu rabbinā mā ittakhadha ṣāḥibataw-walā waladā
verses.translation: And [it teaches] that exalted is the nobleness of our Lord; He has not taken a wife or a son

verses.arabicText: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ شَطَطًۭا
verses.transliteration: Wa-annahu kāna yaqūlu safīhunā ʿalā l-lahi shaṭaṭā
verses.translation: And that our foolish one has been saying about Allah an excessive transgression.

verses.arabicText: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن تَقُولَ ٱلْإِنسُ وَٱلْجِنُّ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًۭا
verses.transliteration: Wa-annā ẓanannā al-lan taqūla l-insu wal-jinu ʿalā l-lahi kadhibā
verses.translation: And we had thought that mankind and the jinn would never speak about Allah a lie.

verses.arabicText: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ رِجَالٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْإِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمْ رَهَقًۭا
verses.transliteration: Wa-annahu kāna rijālum-mina l-insi yaʿūdhūna birijālim-mina l-jini fazādūhum rahaqā
verses.translation: And there were men from mankind who sought refuge in men from the jinn, so they [only] increased them in burden.

verses.arabicText: وَأَنَّهُمْ ظَنُّوا۟ كَمَا ظَنَنتُمْ أَن لَّن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدًۭا
verses.transliteration: Wa-annahum ẓannū kamā ẓanantum al-lay-yabʿatha l-lahu aḥadā
verses.translation: And they had thought, as you thought, that Allah would never send anyone [as a messenger].

verses.arabicText: وَأَنَّا لَمَسْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ فَوَجَدْنَٰهَا مُلِئَتْ حَرَسًۭا شَدِيدًۭا وَشُهُبًۭا
verses.transliteration: Wa-annā lamasnā s-samāa fawajadnāhā muli-at ḥarasan shadīdaw-washuhubā
verses.translation: And we have sought [to reach] the heaven but found it filled with powerful guards and burning flames.

verses.arabicText: وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقْعُدُ مِنْهَا مَقَٰعِدَ لِلسَّمْعِ ۖ فَمَن يَسْتَمِعِ ٱلْءَانَ يَجِدْ لَهُۥ شِهَابًۭا رَّصَدًۭا
verses.transliteration: Wa-annā kunnā naqʿudu min'hā maqāʿida lilssamʿi famay-yastamiʿi l-āna yajid lahu shihābar-raṣadā
verses.translation: And we used to sit therein in positions for hearing, but whoever listens now will find a burning flame lying in wait for him.

verses.arabicText: وَأَنَّا لَا نَدْرِىٓ أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ أَرَادَ بِهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ رَشَدًۭا
verses.transliteration: Wa-annā lā nadrī asharrun urīda biman fī l-arḍi am arāda bihim rabbuhum rashadā
verses.translation: And we do not know [therefore] whether evil is intended for those on earth or whether their Lord intends for them a right course.

verses.arabicText: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّٰلِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدًۭا
verses.transliteration: Wa-annā minnā ṣ-ṣāliḥūna waminnā dūna dhālika kunnā ṭarāiqa qidadā
verses.translation: And among us are the righteous, and among us are [others] not so; we were [of] divided ways.

verses.arabicText: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن نُّعْجِزَ ٱللَّهَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَن نُّعْجِزَهُۥ هَرَبًۭا
verses.transliteration: Wa-annā ẓanannā al-lan-nuʿ'jiza l-laha fī l-arḍi walan-nuʿ'jizahu harabā
verses.translation: And we have become certain that we will never cause failure to Allah upon earth, nor can we escape Him by flight.

verses.arabicText: وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعْنَا ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ فَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِرَبِّهِۦ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخْسًۭا وَلَا رَهَقًۭا
verses.transliteration: Wa-annā lammā samiʿ'nā l-hudā āmannā bihi famay-yu'min birabbihi falā yakhāfu bakhsaw-walā rahaqā
verses.translation: And when we heard the guidance, we believed in it. And whoever believes in his Lord will not fear deprivation or burden.

verses.arabicText: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلْمُسْلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا ٱلْقَٰسِطُونَ ۖ فَمَنْ أَسْلَمَ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ تَحَرَّوْا۟ رَشَدًۭا
verses.transliteration: Wa-annā minnā l-mus'limūna waminnā l-qāsiṭūna faman aslama fa-ulāika taḥarraw rashadā
verses.translation: And among us are Muslims [in submission to Allah], and among us are the unjust. And whoever has become Muslim - those have sought out the right course.

verses.arabicText: وَأَمَّا ٱلْقَٰسِطُونَ فَكَانُوا۟ لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبًۭا
verses.transliteration: Wa-ammā l-qāsiṭūna fakānū lijahannama ḥaṭabā
verses.translation: But as for the unjust, they will be, for Hell, firewood.'

verses.arabicText: وَأَلَّوِ ٱسْتَقَٰمُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسْقَيْنَٰهُم مَّآءً غَدَقًۭا
verses.transliteration: Wa-allawi is'taqāmū ʿalā ṭ-ṭarīqati la-asqaynāhum māan ghadaqā
verses.translation: And [Allah revealed] that if they had remained straight on the way, We would have given them abundant provision

verses.arabicText: لِّنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ ۚ وَمَن يُعْرِضْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِۦ يَسْلُكْهُ عَذَابًۭا صَعَدًۭا
verses.transliteration: Linaftinahum fīhi wamay-yuʿ'riḍ ʿan dhik'ri rabbihi yasluk'hu ʿadhāban ṣaʿadā
verses.translation: So We might test them therein. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord He will put into arduous punishment.

verses.arabicText: وَأَنَّ ٱلْمَسَٰجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلَا تَدْعُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدًۭا
verses.transliteration: Wa-anna l-masājida lillahi falā tadʿū maʿa l-lahi aḥadā
verses.translation: And [He revealed] that the masjids are for Allah, so do not invoke with Allah anyone.

verses.arabicText: وَأَنَّهُۥ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ يَدْعُوهُ كَادُوا۟ يَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِ لِبَدًۭا
verses.transliteration: Wa-annahu lammā qāma ʿabdu l-lahi yadʿūhu kādū yakūnūna ʿalayhi libadā
verses.translation: And that when the Servant of Allah stood up supplicating Him, they almost became about him a compacted mass."

verses.arabicText: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَدْعُوا۟ رَبِّى وَلَآ أُشْرِكُ بِهِۦٓ أَحَدًۭا
verses.transliteration: Qul innamā adʿū rabbī walā ush'riku bihi aḥadā
verses.translation: Say, [O Muhammad], "I only invoke my Lord and do not associate with Him anyone."

verses.arabicText: قُلْ إِنِّى لَآ أَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّۭا وَلَا رَشَدًۭا
verses.transliteration: Qul innī lā amliku lakum ḍarraw-walā rashadā
verses.translation: Say, "Indeed, I do not possess for you [the power of] harm or right direction."

verses.arabicText: قُلْ إِنِّى لَن يُجِيرَنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدٌۭ وَلَنْ أَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مُلْتَحَدًا
verses.transliteration: Qul innī lay-yujīranī mina l-lahi aḥaduw-walan ajida min dūnihi mul'taḥadā
verses.translation: Say, "Indeed, there will never protect me from Allah anyone [if I should disobey], nor will I find in other than Him a refuge.

verses.arabicText: إِلَّا بَلَٰغًۭا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِسَٰلَٰتِهِۦ ۚ وَمَن يَعْصِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا
verses.transliteration: Illā balāgham-mina l-lahi warisālātihi wamay-yaʿṣi l-laha warasūlahu fa-inna lahu nāra jahannama khālidīna fīhā abadā
verses.translation: But [I have for you] only notification from Allah, and His messages." And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger - then indeed, for him is the fire of Hell; they will abide therein forever.

verses.arabicText: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوْا۟ مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَضْعَفُ نَاصِرًۭا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدًۭا
verses.transliteration: Ḥattā idhā ra-aw mā yūʿadūna fasayaʿlamūna man aḍʿafu nāṣiraw-wa-aqallu ʿadadā
verses.translation: [The disbelievers continue] until, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who is weaker in helpers and less in number.

verses.arabicText: قُلْ إِنْ أَدْرِىٓ أَقَرِيبٌۭ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ أَمْ يَجْعَلُ لَهُۥ رَبِّىٓ أَمَدًا
verses.transliteration: Qul in adrī aqarībum-mā tūʿadūna am yajʿalu lahu rabbī amadā
verses.translation: Say, "I do not know if what you are promised is near or if my Lord will grant for it a [long] period."

verses.arabicText: عَٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَلَا يُظْهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيْبِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا
verses.transliteration: ʿālimu l-ghaybi falā yuẓ'hiru ʿalā ghaybihi aḥadā
verses.translation: [He is] Knower of the unseen, and He does not disclose His [knowledge of the] unseen to anyone

verses.arabicText: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱرْتَضَىٰ مِن رَّسُولٍۢ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَسْلُكُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِۦ رَصَدًۭا
verses.transliteration: Illā mani ir'taḍā mir-rasūlin fa-innahu yasluku min bayni yadayhi wamin khalfihi raṣadā
verses.translation: Except whom He has approved of messengers, and indeed, He sends before each messenger and behind him observers

verses.arabicText: لِّيَعْلَمَ أَن قَدْ أَبْلَغُوا۟ رِسَٰلَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ وَأَحْصَىٰ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عَدَدًۢا
verses.transliteration: Liyaʿlama an qad ablaghū risālāti rabbihim wa-aḥāṭa bimā ladayhim wa-aḥṣā kulla shayin ʿadadā
verses.translation: That he may know that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord; and He has encompassed whatever is with them and has enumerated all things in number.
